# Aymen Naghmouchi

> Personal site of Aymen Naghmouchi, a Software Engineer based in Ticino, Switzerland. Node.js website maintainer, open source contributor to Node.js and Jakarta EE, and a Google Summer of Code 2019 alumnus.

The site is a single page at https://aymen.xyz/ with sections for open source work, projects, experience, articles and talks. Project data comes from GitHub. Several projects are hosted as subpaths of this domain (for example https://aymen.xyz/NeuronDump/).

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/aymen94): source code for all projects
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aymennaghmouchi/): full work history
- [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/users/4671263/aymen)
- [Medium](https://medium.com/@aymennaghmouchi): articles
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/~aymen94): published packages

## Open source

- [Node.js website](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.org): maintainer since 2018
- [nodejs.dev](https://github.com/nodejs/nodejs.dev): team member, 2019-2022
- [Jakarta EE 10](https://www.eclipse.org/lists/jakartaee-tck-dev/msg01718.html): contributor, 2021-2022
- [Google Summer of Code 2019](https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/archive/2019/projects/6232664103714816): OpenAPI 3 support for io-utils with Developers Italia

## Projects

- [WAMR3D](https://wamr3d.org/): 3D engine in Rust and WebAssembly for WebGPU/WebGL with a three.js-style API
- [NeuronDump](https://aymen.xyz/NeuronDump/): inspect, edit and diff local LLMs (GGUF), fully offline
- [snekweb](https://github.com/aymen94/snekweb): dependency-free Node.js HTTP framework
- [node-ipconfig](https://github.com/aymen94/node-ipconfig): promise-based parser for Windows ipconfig output
- [WebRAGStudio](https://github.com/aymen94/WebRAGStudio): self-hosted RAG workspace for local documents
- [magicwebtools](https://magicwebtools.pages.dev): 900+ in-browser developer tools
- [Project data (JSON)](https://aymen.xyz/data/projects.json): pinned and recently updated GitHub repositories
